title: rnel: Refined Neutrosophic Evidential Logic
description: A toolkit for neutrosophic evidence. RNEL 0.3.0 consolidates evidence tuples, Subjective Logic, credal and conflict diagnostics, refined neutrosophic statistics, DSmT, plithogenic and copula operators, score functions, learning utilities, and the reproducibility runner for the book Neutrosophic Evidence. Academic, experimental software; the API may change.
